text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for all your support last year.
I look forward to working with you again this year~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, that's enough of the stiff greetings.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Geez, you sound just like an old uncle!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Since I was always surrounded by adults growing up,
they were constantly nagging me about giving proper greetings.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, we're gonna be together for a looong time,
Trainer. Gotta make sure we do things properly."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right.
About this year's resolutions.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah.
Well, there technically is one, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...No, mine should be last!
Let's hear from you first, Trainer."
And so, the New Year's resolution I decide with Nice Nature is...
choice_data_list: Let's always stay mindful while training!
Be health-conscious and watch what you eat!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho.
Like giving meaning to each and every single thing, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You mean like, what kind of effect
this training has, right?

It seems Nice Nature has also been conscious of thinking through her training up until now.
She really is smart. In that case...
choice_data_list: Nice Nature could think it through even more.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's an oddly concerning way to put it, but...
Okaay, I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So, maybe I'll try to see right through the hidden motives behind your instructions, Trainer-san~
...And so, after sharing our New Year's resolutions, there was one more piece of news I had to tell her—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? A meal~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I am a maiden of age, you know? I do try to be pretty mindful of it, though.
choice_data_list: How about grabbing some snacks at the shopping street?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh!?
H-How dost thou know of that...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, the folks were nice enough to offer, right?
It'd feel bad turning them down."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer!
Can't you let just sneaking a bite slide?
choice_data_list: If I eat a little less for dinner instead...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You're so mean~!
...And so, after sharing our New Year's resolutions, there was one more piece of news I had to tell her—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... Here we go again.
Talking about "standing out" or "special talents."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's the kind of thing I'm worst at.
That's what they call "talent," isn't it?
choice_data_list: However, it will become a weapon unique to Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I mean, you're right, but...
Just looking at the words gives me the creeps...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: A weapon that's uniquely mine, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well! A year is a long time.
For now, might as well search as best we can~.
...And so, after sharing our New Year's resolutions, there was one more piece of news I had to tell her—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"U-Umm... Trainer dear.
What... did you just say?"
choice_data_list: Tokai Teio is running in the Wakagoma S too!
Tokai Teio is running in the Wakagoma S too!

text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio, the impenetrable wall and the strongest of the generation.
A match against her has come early, taking place in an Open class race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uhyaa, thought so.
Guess I didn't mishear after all...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"This race was supposed to be my chance to show what I can do.
And now Teio's joining in too...? Come on, what gives!"
choice_data_list: There's still a chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, I know you kind of have to say that, Trainer, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... ugh.
Guess I just have to do it~...

Though her conflict was plain to see, for now
she seemed to accept competing against Tokai Teio.
If we can just tune her up before the big day, we have a fighting chance!
By the way—
choice_data_list: What resolution did Nice Nature make?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh!?
Y-You're making me say it now!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, er, umm...
Let's seeeeee... you see...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I will stand.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!
"Smoothly taking the lead"!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's not true, okay?!
I'm not the one who decided this!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"When I went to greet everyone in the shopping district the other day,
we realized I hadn't come up with my resolution yet."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And then everyone started hyping me up like crazy,
saying stuff like, "Let's set a massive goal!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I was just going with the flow, alright...?! Really, that's all it was!
choice_data_list: I'm gonna cruise right to victory in the next race!
Let's cruise to an easy victory in the next race!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Auuugh, no way, no way, I can't do this!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aah, I knew I shouldn't have said anything~!
